exposure: Pelvic floor myofascial manipulation intervention during the second stage of labor
cohort: The study included 60 primiparas who were expecting a vaginal delivery at the Second Affiliated Hospital of Hainan Medical College in China.
finding: Pelvic floor myofascial manipulation intervention during the second stage of labor in primiparas significantly reduced the duration of the second stage of labor, the amount of bleeding during labor, the pain during labor, and improved neonatal Apgar scores.
mod_finding: The rate of episiotomy was lower in the experimental group compared to the control group, though this difference was not statistically significant.
followup_time: Immediate postpartum (neonatal Apgar scores, postpartum hemorrhage volume)
gest_age: Gestational time was measured and found to have no significant difference between the two groups at baseline.
